authority.route: get_current_user plus main's DB-backed _require_community_skill_reviewer (TEAM_LEAD+ from the current User row)
authority.service_resolution: _resolve_actor reads the authoritative User row in a fresh session: active status and role_level(role) >= role_level(UserRole.TEAM_LEAD)
authority.service_claim: _claim_actor executes a guarded no-op UPDATE User matching id, is_active, status, role and raw tenant inside the decision transaction
authority.zero_match: 409 AUTHORITY_CHANGED with verification.effect=none; rollback; peer skill preserved; zero audit rows
authority.read_failure: 503 AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE; no target or audit work
authority.scope: global/system community registry; the audit is attributed to the acting reviewer's current tenant/user

routes.effect: authority claim + guarded UPDATE status Untrusted -> Active plus one AuditLog receipt in the same transaction
routes.transitions: Untrusted -> Active; already Active new operation -> already_applied/effect=none; same-operation replay -> already_applied; stale material or authority -> 409 effect=none

routes.effect: authority claim + guarded community-row DELETE plus one AuditLog tombstone in the same transaction
routes.transitions: missing -> 404; same-operation tombstone -> already_applied; stale/competing/authority change -> 409 peer preserved or effect=none

durable_ledger.metadata: schema, operation_id, action, event_type, target/request/material digests, actor identity and role, prior/result status
durable_ledger.sensitive_material: no raw skill body, package list, scan payload, secret, SQL parameter or exception text in the receipt or logs
durable_ledger.readback: fresh session; audit fields and target state/material digest must match

parallel_writers.routes: sole verified writers for community skill status/delete
parallel_writers.removed_branch_engine: core.skill_review_write_service deleted; its unique current-authority claim was ported into the community service
parallel_writers.SkillRegistryService: promote_skill/delete_skill retained for internal/test callers; routes do not use them
